normalDrain.interpretation: The normally drained child was not captured by target task-query observations. This is not proof that a live setuid ps task became readable. Its final zero-total sample records confirmedGone=1, not unavailable-to-zero conversion.

realHarness.limit: One ps inventory overlap and no captured denied sample in this run do not establish that a live ps task was measured or exclude intermittent later denial. No browser or Shim authentication was exercised.

failClosedAndCleanup.chronology: The source releases/drains and reaps the controlled ps before returning the incomplete group sample to Runner. Therefore the later group-probe denial is not evidence that this controlled ps remained alive during cleanup.
failClosedAndCleanup.limit: Worker exit0 and exact-child reap do not establish whole-group disappearance. No process-state snapshot at the failing group probe was retained; group cleanup remains unverified.

nextStepAssessment.assessment: The proposed same-UID known-child zombie-only read-probe/reap experiment is a focused discriminator. A candidate reap-before-probe ordering change must retain errors for live/foreign/unknown or denied remaining groups and must preserve descendant verification.
nextStepAssessment.execution: No additional Mac job, full build or repair is performed by this review; no unchanged full build is proposed as evidence.
nextStepAssessment.nativeHarnessAlternative: A ps-free ordinary read-only API replacement is design only. Exact birth/argv/profile identity, unknown/ambiguity handling, bounds and pre-signal generation validation require separate implementation and small Mac validation.
